title: "Create the Dataset with the Effect Size LRR d of Species"

date: "2024-04-26"
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r create-ds_species_effect_sizes_LRR}

# --- CREATE DATASET WITH THE EFFECT SIZE LRR D OF SPECIES DOMINANCES --- #

# Prepare the data 

filtered_data = ds_ecosystems_effect_size %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # Keep only heterotrophic ecosystems as autotrophic ecosystems were
  # monocultures. Also, keep only connected ecosystems because we are 
  # calculating effect sizes for connected ecosystems compared to unconnected
  # ecosystems.
  
  filter(trophic_type == "heterotrophic",
         connection == "connected") %>%
  filter(time_point > 1) %>%

  # Select useful columns
  
  select(time_point, 
         ecosystem_size_ml,
         trophic_type,
         connection,
         disturbance_percentage,
         paste0(protist_species_dominance, "_LRR"),
         paste0(protist_species_dominance, "_LRR_upper"),
         paste0(protist_species_dominance, "_LRR_lower")) 

# Create the dataset with the effect size means

ds_species_effect_sizes_LRR = filtered_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("dominance_LRR"), 
               names_to = "species", 
               values_to = "effect_size") %>%
  select(time_point,
         ecosystem_size_ml,
         trophic_type,
         connection,
         disturbance_percentage,
         species,
         effect_size)

# Create the dataset with the effect size upper 95 % CI

ds_species_effect_sizes_LRR_upper = filtered_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("dominance_LRR_upper"), 
               names_to = "species", 
               values_to = "upper_95_CI") %>%
  select(upper_95_CI)

# Create the dataset with the effect size lower 95 % CI

ds_species_effect_sizes_LRR_lower = filtered_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("dominance_LRR_lower"), 
               names_to = "species", 
               values_to = "lower_95_CI") %>%
  select(lower_95_CI)

# Bind mean, and 95 % CIs

ds_species_effect_sizes_LRR = cbind(ds_species_effect_sizes_LRR, 
                                    ds_species_effect_sizes_LRR_upper, 
                                    ds_species_effect_sizes_LRR_lower) %>%
  mutate(species = str_remove(species, "_bioarea_mm2_per_ml_dominance_LRR")) %>%
  mutate(species = factor(x = species, 
                          levels = c("Tet", "Col", "Eup", "Pau", "Cep", "Lox", "Pca", "Spi_te", "Ble", "Spi")))
```
